commentary: Market direction is the supreme arbiter: O'Neil's CANSLIM discipline reminds us that three out of four equities inevitably capitulate to the general market trend. With Nifty violating critical 22,500 support amidst relentless FII liquidation and an abysmal advance-decline ratio (594 advances vs 2,789 declines), Stan Weinstein's framework identifies broad distribution. Even textbook Stage 2 breakouts face elevated failure rates in a WEAK tape. Jesse Livermore's timeless principle to never fight the market and Minervini's progressive exposure dictate utmost caution: prioritize cash, insist on confirmed earnings acceleration, restrict exposure to isolated relative-strength leaders, and enforce non-negotiable stops.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Trading above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, hovering within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot at 104.09 on 1.63x volume. While price action shows base stabilization and RSI 57 is neutral, the pattern lacks structural tightness and high relative strength against the tape.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe top-line contraction (-56.3% YoY) and net profit decline (-25.5% YoY). Low ROCE (5.6%) and thin operating margins (~3%) violate CANSLIM quality filters, reflecting severe input cost pressure and lack of institutional operational leverage.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails on a close below 97.24; cut losses immediately if supply overwhelms the pivot floor.

ACE.technical: Constructive double bottom with a 12.8% cup and 5.6% handle in the upper half of base. Price trades firmly above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA with positive MACD, setting up a pivot breakout trigger at 1269.27.
ACE.fundamental: Dominant mobile and tower crane market share (>60%). Zero net debt, robust ROCE of 31.6%, and EBITDA margin expansion to 14.9% demonstrate institutional quality, though Q1 EPS growth (+22.4%) falls just shy of the CANSLIM 25% threshold.
ACE.risk: Thesis invalidates below handle low at 1190.67; enforce strict stop discipline against broad market headwinds.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Maintains Stage 2 structure above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, trading within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot at 1861.56 on 1.49x volume. Relative strength is resilient versus benchmark decline, though RSI 53 remains neutral.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Formidable infrastructure moat handling ~27% of India's port volumes. Robust operating margins (~64%) and healthy cash flows support stability, but quarterly EPS deceleration to +9.2% YoY caps growth qualification despite strong +18.6% top-line expansion.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Fails on a breakdown below 1774.89 support; exit promptly if institutional distribution intensifies.

AEGISLOG.technical: Exemplary Stage 2 market leader executing a 3-candle pullback to its rising 21-EMA near new highs. Confirmed a bullish reclaim candle above the prior midpoint, preserving an immaculate trend template well above 50 and 200-SMAs.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Sensational CANSLIM numbers with Q1 PAT jumping 212% YoY to ₹545 Cr and revenue up 37.1%. Driven by expanding LPG logistics throughput, sustained distribution margin expansion, comfortable leverage, and massive port terminal capacity additions underway.
AEGISLOG.risk: Violates structure below the 21-EMA swing low at 1383.09; cut loss without hesitation.

ALBERTDAVD.technical: Forming a multi-month Stage 1 double bottom base, pressing neckline resistance at 932.78 on 1.54x volume. Reclaimed key moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200) with RSI 57 displaying constructive momentum during index liquidation.
ALBERTDAVD.fundamental: Sharp turnaround with Q1 revenue jumping 39.6% YoY to ₹129 Cr and net profit reaching ₹32 Cr. Balance sheet is virtually debt-free, though high other income contribution (₹28 Cr) and single-quarter track record necessitate confirmation of core operational durability.
ALBERTDAVD.risk: Pattern breaks down on a close below 878.59; honor stop immediately to avoid base failure.

ALICON.technical: High-volume 20-session breakout clearing 782.78 on a massive 26.65x average volume surge. Price is extended from moving averages but demonstrates exceptional relative strength, trending firmly above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA with positive MACD.
ALICON.fundamental: Leading aluminum die-caster benefiting from auto component demand, delivering 38.3% YoY revenue growth. Working capital cycle compressed to 11.6 days and debt/equity is manageable at 0.61, though EPS growth (+23%) marginally misses the strict 25% CANSLIM standard.
ALICON.risk: Breakout fails if price retreats below 704.98; exit immediately to prevent giving back capital.
